build_phoc_vector: build a PHOC feature vector from a text token string using the build_phoc function
create_text_embedding: create a 604-dimensional float32 numpy array embedding from an alphanumeric text token
test_build_phoc: test the build_phoc function by passing a lowercase alphanumeric string and verifying the output shape
refactor_phoc_alphabet: refactor the build_phoc module to support additional characters beyond lowercase letters and digits
summarize_phoc_module: summarize the PHOC module that converts text tokens into pyramid histogram of character n-grams feature vectors
